scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,inspector -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/server" "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/inspector"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run test -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run test -w @ay-ple/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-fake && npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run build -w @ay-ple/server && npm run build -w @ay-ple/inspector
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-fake && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/server && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/inspector
